title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse
tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

faults.what: The mushroom picture gives the robot two bags: an orange-flapped yellow handbag on the left and a yellow mailbag on the right, adding an unrequested accessory and changing her design.
Rain streaks visibly cross the robot beneath the mushroom cap, weakening the impression that she is sheltered.
The cottage picture is smoother and glossier, while the mushroom picture has more pronounced textured linework; the rendering style is not exactly consistent.
The object held at the cottage door reads ambiguously as a small flap bag or envelope rather than a clearly identifiable parcel.

judge.summary: The two follow-ups depict the requested settings attractively, but an extra bag and inconsistent rendering need correction, and fidelity to the unseen original cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
must_haves.why: The initial train-station illustration is not provided.

must_haves.item: The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
must_haves.why: Both supplied pictures show these features, but the initial picture cannot be inspected.

must_haves.item: The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
must_haves.why: The first robot is unavailable for comparison. The supplied robots share their main features, although their accessories differ.

must_haves.item: One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
must_haves.why: The cottage image shows her holding a small package at the door, though its form is ambiguous; the other places her beneath a giant mushroom in visible rain.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: The two supplied images are separate square, text-free storybook illustrations, with some rendering differences; the third image is not available.
